picks.why: Chunky, soft moulded roofs and a compact mass match the real lighthouse; reads instantly as a crooked house. Candidate 1 is thinner and more angular.
Centered, full silhouette with a plain upright buckle. Candidate 1 has a fussier tilted buckle; candidate 2 sits off-center.
Squat, wide pumpkin with clear ribs and true proportions. Candidate 1 is taller and rounder, with a weaker carved face.
Fewest extras: just a small flame with no invented stone ring, so the pot stays the single subject.
Long hexagonal coffin shape reads on both lid and base, with the lining kept quiet. Candidate 2 is stubby and adds a tree; candidate 1 hides the base outline.
Most restrained: simple stone, one moss patch and one leaf. Candidates 1 and 3 add pebbles, plants and a flower.
Centered, clean turned stem and simple arms with believable candle scale. Candidate 1 has odd arm collars; candidate 2 sits off-center.
Well-centered ball on a chunky, simple gold stand with a soft swirl. Candidate 2 sits off-center and candidate 1 has a spindlier stand.
Fills the frame like the real cards, with natural cat proportions. Candidate 2 is smaller, off-center and has oversized eyes.
Soft, chunky moulded bristles and a solid handle match the real card's rendering. Candidate 2 is thin and off-center; candidate 1 is stringier.
